notes: Manufacturer product/spec page (Kramer, redirects from kramerav.com to www1.kramerav.com), cross-checked against Kramer's own connector diagram image (kramer_wp-211t_connection_diagram.jpg) which labels the front panel "INPUT 1"/"INPUT 2" HDMI jacks and the rear board "HDBT OUT" RJ-45 plus a 2-pin captive screw terminal labeled "GND / +5V". This is a 1-gang in-wall device, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). HDMI grade set to hdmi-2.0 per manufacturer's explicit "HDMI 2.0 and HDCP 2.2 compliant" statement (max 4K@60Hz 4:2:0, HDCP 2.2, does not support HDCP-1.4 conversion); the stated 8.91Gbps max data rate reflects the specific 4K60(4:2:0) mode rather than full HDMI 2.0 18Gbps ceiling. The HDBT Out RJ-45 carries HDBaseT video/audio/control (manufacturer lists it under "Outputs") — grade omitted since HDBaseT has no defined grade scale in this system, but note it is also a PoE acceptor (draws power from a PoE-capable HDBaseT link over that same RJ-45) in addition to/instead of the local GND/+5V DC terminal; power consumption 780mA (local) or 9W (via PoE). No RS-232/IR ports on this transmitter model (present on companion receivers like TP-789R, not on WP-211T itself). Two physical SKUs share identical electrical I/O: WP-211T/US(W/B) (US 1-gang Decora, reviewed here) and WP-211T/EU-80/86(W) (EU/UK frame) — only frame/faceplate size differs, confirmed via Kramer's own configuration images.
